I could talk about how awful the fact that ALL of his abilities scale from different things (q scales with AD, W with HP, E with bonus armor and MR, R with ap and a really bad ratio too LUL).  But, the main focus of this video is simply on the idea that Ornn's kit is unbalanceable for the game. He has aspects of his kit that should never exist in League of Legends. 

After I finish a video, I always see small things that people might misinterpret. For example, with I compared Ornn E to Poppy E, I obviously understand that these abilities are totally different and Poppy E is actually a superior ability because it's faster and more versatile. What I'm trying to compare is the Max Reward for both abilities are pretty similar, you're trying to hit them next to terrain. I hope I didn't create misunderstandings.

snippet.title: The Truth behind Scapegoating / Raging in NA Solo Queue
snippet.description:
This was speech I gave on stream in the moments right after a really one sided game in which our team turned really toxic on each other and myself.  A lot of solo queue players treat the game as you vs 9 other players. The teams you get feel somehow worse than what you're expecting or want to have. The truth is that Solo Queue IS UNFAIR and you shouldn't expect it to be. It's a challenge mode made to see if you can win despite having unfair odds against you some of the time. Yes, it would be ideal if Solo Queue would have balanced matchmaking and teammates were equally skilled as your opponents 100% of the time, but it will never happen. Mistakes WILL HAPPEN, that will never ever change in this game. You'll climb all the way to Challenger and realize that mistakes will have abeit less frequently but your opponents will get even better. You have to develope a resolve to your own mistakes BUT also the mistakes of your team. Calling them out in a non-constructive way will simply make you and your team play worse in that game. In other words, you has nothing but a negative impact on the game itself. 


One thing that I would go back and change what I say would have been what I said about Korean Solo Queue. Upon reflection, I don't actually think this video's theme is just limited to NA solo Queue. I actually think it's on every region, and it's just simply how Solo Queue feels.

I built magic pen afterwards because they didn't have much magic resist and allowed me to do true damage to most of their carries. If you ever get super fed on Kassadin, give it a try.

snippet.title: New Warwick OP?
snippet.description:
My first game on the new Warwick. I think the proper way to play him will probably to not max his Q ability first. That is because the mana cost goes way up and the damage doesn't go up that much. It's probably better to max his W ability first to make his ganks a lot stronger. 2nd ability to max might end up being E because that'll be when teamfights begin but also make his dueling even stronger.

For item build, I think you're going to have to end up going tank instead of bloodrazor. Cinderhulk / trinity force mid game might be core on him (similar reasons as why you build it on hecarim). Although, I really liked the tiamat on him for the jungle clear so I'm still very unsure on how I'd itemize him
